bayts.text: I have written (this poem) when my whole being had parted from sin and association, and already before my Lord had purchased what I had sold Him through renunciation.
My words, my intentions and my deeds have turned to Him (Allah) who has sufficed me against evil, harm and doubt.
The Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), the Defender (Al-Māniʿ), has sufficed me against all the enemies, and has led to me beloved ones through whom I manifest devotion.
I have written with the intent of giving thanks to my Lord, addressing him (Muḥammad) whose love has removed straitness from my breast.
You were noble and surpassed all, O best of the Sent: upon you a blessing (salāt) whose fragrance has put musk to shame.
You lifted the darkness from us and guided us all together: upon you a peace whose scent disdains the bunka (a prized aromatic essence, al-bunk).
My distresses, O Key (Al-Miftāḥ), you have dispelled from me; and already before you had driven away the enemies, ignorance and falsehood.
You clothed the naked just as you fed the hungry, and delivered him from his fetters, O best of those who unbind.
You dispelled the darkness of my heart and protected my whole being by the safekeeping of Him (Allah) who, whenever one complains, answers the complaint.
Your cups give me drink, bringing me glad tidings, and you have led to me an outpouring that has put the sea and the ships to shame.
Your Book (O Lord) is my religion, my intimate friend and my companion; through it the Guide (Al-Hādī) has guided me and purified my soul.
A noble Book, from a Generous One who honours, through which I have been kept from the enemies, from sin and from association.
To my Lord my praise: He has erased the fetters from me and led to me an outpouring that has put the sea and the pouring rain to shame.
His is praise and thanksgiving, without end; He is the One, the Enricher, who has multiplied the little.
To Him my thanksgiving after praise, as I address Him whose generosity has led to me what has put the steady rain to shame.
Yours (O Prophet) is precedence and pre-eminence, O best of masters, with the One, the Subduer, the sublime Lord of creation.
Yours are knowledge, works and all good: upon you God's blessing, O you who have surpassed (even) the origin.
Yours is excellence, O Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār), O master of creation: upon you God's peace, O you who have erased humiliations.
You are truly the Imām of the Messengers: it has been transmitted that they met you in the Night Journey (al-Isrāʾ), and all prayed (behind you).
You have put on the garments of glory, excellence and sublimity, and in you are virtues that have left all powerless (to describe them).
You endured from the enemies what showed us all together that you are the lion who routed their host.
To whoever comes seeking from you a gift together with guidance, (you grant) gifts of gladness that repel poverty and famine.
For whoever ignorance has led towards you in rashness, (there is) a severe punishment that leaves as its legacy misery and violent death.
For you, at all times, I seek from my God His blessing upon you, together with peace, O you who have erased the fetters.
In God, who has led the Law (ash-sharʿ) to me through the Chosen One (Muḥammad), I have placed my trust, as servant and attendant, fearing no downfall.
In Him is my reliance, well pleased with Him, Servant of the Servant (Muḥammad) whom He made journey by night and who passed beyond the seven (heavens).
Upon the Chosen One, the best of creation, Muḥammad, be the blessing of Him (Allah) who has led to me what has made my ease everlasting.
Upon you God's blessing, O best of the elect, together with His peace, O you who have guided the trunk and the branches.
Upon you the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) to whom all command belongs, just as through you He has led to me privileges and the return (home).
Upon you a blessing joined with peace, together with your company, from the Vast, the Everlasting, who has made my abundance everlasting.
You have risen to a height with which none vies, save one doomed to a wretchedness that draws upon itself curse and rejection.
My refuge is in Him (Allah) who has exalted you as servant and master, Intimate Friend and Beloved, and has led His remembrance to me, once and for all.
His gifts, on land and sea, lead me to give Him thanks, ever since He made good the soul and the pasture.
His wonders, on land and sea, have appeared to me, because you (O Prophet) are the one I serve; and He has brought benefit to me.
My sciences, my spiritual knowledge (ʿirfān) and my striving are pure, for Him (Allah) who through you has led to me the writings and the Law.
My hardship, you have erased it from me through God's erasing; and my life was purified by Him who turned the downfall towards others.
Towards the Lord of creation, Him alone, my whole being has turned, with what has been chosen for me, without harmer or burden.
My tongue, my pens, my heart and my body belong to the Enricher, the Generous, the Bestower of benefit, exalted above all likeness.
For us He has sent the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), a servant placed foremost, Intimate Friend and Beloved, surpassing the entire multitude.
To him, at all times, my eulogies, as a Servant addressing him; and in his eulogies there has come to me the most fruitful of lawful gains.
Yours are the radiant miracles, O best of masters: upon you God's blessing, O you who gather what was scattered.
Truly you were most patient, grateful and sincere in counsel: upon you God's peace, O you who erase ignorance.
Yours are the extraordinary miracles with which, in former times, without dispute, all the Messengers came.
To you the tree came walking on its trunk, at your call, just as the full moon split, witness then to (your) excellence.
(Praise) to Him (Allah) who sent down the verses by which you have guided me: a mighty Book, which has made the Truth manifest through (His) grace.
My tongue and my limbs are servants to Him through you, and to Him I have entrusted my spirit and my soul, together with my deeds.
To Him, at all times, my intentions, my knowledge and my service, my spirit, my body and my whole being, without any loss.
You are truly the Intimate Friend, the Beloved, O best of intercessors; and your like the Everlasting (Allah), who has protected my whole being, never created.
